title: phillyrea media var. angustifolia
intro: Phillyrea media var. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Mock Privet, is a plant species within the family Oleaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Narrow-leaved Mock Privet include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
